in_marathi.name: Rattan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Jewel, rod of power
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rattan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rattan is a name of Sanskrit origin that means 'jewel' or 'rod of power'. It is derived from the word 'rath', which means 'chariot'. The name is associated with strength, prosperity, and longevity.
